The eighth season of the ''[[Bleach (TV series)|Bleach]]'' [[anime]] series is named the {{nihongo|'''Arrancar: The Fierce Fight arc'''|破面・激闘篇|Arankaru Gekitō Hen}}.<ref name="AmazonJPDVD1"/> The episodes are directed by [[Noriyuki Abe]], and produced by [[TV Tokyo]], [[Dentsu]], and [[Studio Pierrot]].<ref name="staff">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/staff.html|title=ぴえろ BLEACH =ブリーチ=|publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=2009-04-07}}</ref> The season adapts [[Tite Kubo]]'s ''[[Bleach (manga)|Bleach]]'' [[manga]] series from the [[List of Bleach chapters#vol29|29th]] volume to the [[List of Bleach chapters#vol32|32nd]] volume (chapters 252–286). The season follows [[Ichigo Kurosaki]] reuniting with [[Orihime Inoue]], while his friends fight the [[List of hollows in Bleach#Espada|Espadas]], the strongest version of the Arrancar sent by [[Sousuke Aizen]].

The season aired from December 2007 to April 2008.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes12/|title=List of ''Bleach'' episode titles (144-154)|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=2008-10-12|archive-date=2012-10-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121001060154/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes12/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes14/|title=List of ''Bleach'' episode titles (166-177)|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=2008-10-12|archive-date=2012-12-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121201023353/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes14/|url-status=dead}}</ref> The English adaptation of the ''Bleach'' anime is licensed by [[Viz Media]],<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2006-03-15/viz-officially-announces-bleach-anime|title=Viz Officially Announces Bleach Anime|date=2006-03-15|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=2009-04-13}}</ref> and the season aired on [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Adult Swim]] from September to November 2009.<ref name="firsteight"/><ref name="secondeight"/> Four DVD compilations, each containing four episodes of the season, were released by [[Aniplex]] between May 28 and August 27, 2008.<ref name="AmazonJPDVD1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B00158HD2O/|title=BLEACH 破面(アランカル)·激闘篇 1|language=ja|access-date=2008-09-30}}</ref><ref name="AmaznoJPDVD4">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B001AVJPRC/|title=BLEACH 破面(アランカル)·激闘篇 4|language=ja|access-date=2008-09-30}}</ref> Viz Media released the season in two separate DVD boxes on June 21 and September 6, 2011, respectively. The first box, however, also contains episodes from the [[Bleach season 7|previous season]].<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B004PHSTTS/|title=Bleach Uncut Box Set 9|website=Amazon |access-date=2011-10-04}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0051SFSAS/|title=Bleach Uncut Box Set 10|website=Amazon |access-date=2011-10-04}}</ref>

The episodes use three pieces of [[theme music]]: one opening theme and two closing themes. The opening theme is "[[After Dark (Asian Kung-Fu Generation song)|After Dark]]" by [[Asian Kung-Fu Generation]].<ref name="music1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071026101300/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2007-10-26|language=ja}}</ref> The first closing theme is [[Kousuke Atari]]'s {{nihongo|"Tane o Maku Hibi"|種をまく日々||{{lit|Seed-Scattering Days}}}},<ref name="music1" /> which switches in episode 154 to {{nihongo|"Kansha."|感謝。||{{lit|Gratitude.}}}} by [[RSP (band)|RSP]].<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080123125732/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2008-01-23|language=ja}}</ref> To promote the second ''Bleach'' featured film, ''[[Bleach: The DiamondDust Rebellion]]'', the opening and closing credits for episode 152 to 154 use footage from the film, which was released on December 22, 2007.<ref name="BleachFilm2ANN">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2007-07-09/second-bleach-film's-title-date-revealed|title=Second ''Bleach'' Film's Title, Date Revealed|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=2009-04-14}}</ref><ref name="BleachFilm2BoxOffice">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2007-12-27/japanese-box-office-december-22-23-bleach-film-at-no.4|title=Japanese Box Office, December 22–23: Bleach Film at #4 (Updated)|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=2009-04-14}}</ref>

{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 8
| EpisodeNumber   = 152
| EpisodeNumber2  = 1
| Title           = Ichigo Strikes Back! This Is My Bankai
| TranslitTitle   = Ichigo Hangeki! Koitsu ga Ore no Bankai da
| NativeTitle     = 一護反撃！こいつが俺の卍解だ
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Yasuhito Nishikata
| DirectedBy      = Tomoko Hiramuki
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|12|12}}
| AltDate         = September 27, 2009
| ShortSummary    = [[Ichigo Kurosaki]] continues his fight with the [[List of hollows in Bleach#Privaron Espada|Privaron Espada]] [[List of hollows in Bleach#Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio|Dordonii Alessandro Del Socacchio]], and Dordonii easily overpowers Ichigo, leading him to demand that Ichigo use his ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#bankai|bankai]]''. Ichigo refuses and Dordonii uses a ''cero'' blast in response. [[List of hollows in Bleach#Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck|Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck]] blocks the blast by swallowing it and fires it back at Dordonii. When Dordonii attacks Nel, Ichigo uses his ''bankai'' to stop the attack. However, Dordonii requests that Ichigo use his [[List of Bleach characters#Hollow Ichigo|hollow powers]] to fight him. Ichigo dons his hollow mask and disables Dordonii with a single strike. Nel heals Dordonii with her saliva at Ichigo's request, and Dordonii explains that he had hoped to regain his position as a full Espada by defeating Ichigo at full power. After being completely healed, he attacks Ichigo again.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}
{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 8
| EpisodeNumber   = 153
| EpisodeNumber2  = 2
| Title           = The Devilish Research! Szayelaporro's Plan
| TranslitTitle   = Akuma no Kenkyū! Zaeruaporo no Takurami
| NativeTitle     = 悪魔の研究！ザエルアポロの企み
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Takeshi Shirai<hr>Natsuko Suzuki
| DirectedBy      = Mitsutaka Noshitani
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|12|19}}
| AltDate         = October 4, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Dordonii is struck down by Ichigo once again, and to thank Ichigo for using his full power against him, Dordonii fights [[List of hollows in Bleach#Rudbornn Chelute|Rudbornn Chelute]] and the Exequias, a group of [[List of hollows in Bleach|arrancar]]s specializing in eliminating intruders, to allow Ichigo to retreat. When [[Sousuke Aizen]] learns of this, he asks who ordered the Exequias to attack Ichigo, and the [[List of hollows in Bleach#Espada|Espada]] [[List of hollows in Bleach#Szayelaporro Grantz|Szayelaporro Grantz]] takes responsibility. Aizen forgives him, noting that Dordonii's body will help Szayelaporro's research. Meanwhile, [[Uryū Ishida]] is battling the Privaron Espada [[List of hollows in Bleach#Cirucci Sanderwicci|Cirucci Sanderwicci]], and Rukia encounters the Espada [[List of hollows in Bleach#Aaroniero Arruruerie|Aaroniero Arruruerie]]. Aaroniero removes his mask, revealing the face of [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Kaien Shiba|Kaien Shiba]], the former lieutenant of the thirteenth division that Rukia had killed.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}
{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 8
| EpisodeNumber   = 154
| EpisodeNumber2  = 3
| Title           = Rukia and Kaien, the Sorrowful Reunion
| TranslitTitle   = Rukia to Kaien, Kanashimi no Saikai
| NativeTitle     = ルキアと海燕、哀しみの再会
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Hitoyuki Matsui
| DirectedBy      = Yasuo Iwamoto
| WrittenBy       = [[Rika Nakase]]
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|12|26}}
| AltDate         = October 4, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Rukia converses with Aaroniero, and realizes that he is the real Kaien, who states that after he was killed, he was resurrected in [[Bleach (manga)#Setting|Hueco Mundo]], where he became one of Aizen's Espadas. Kaien offers Rukia a chance to atone for killing him by allowing him to kill her, and Rukia accepts, with the caveat that she will be allowed to rescue [[Orihime Inoue]]. Kaien reveals that he was joking, and instead, instructs her to kill all of her friends. Realizing that he is an imposter, Rukia begins to fight Kaien, and Kaien quickly gains the upper hand, as he was the one who taught Rukia how to fight.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}
{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 8
| EpisodeNumber   = 155
| EpisodeNumber2  = 4
| Title           = Rukia Retaliates! Release the Desperate Kidō
| TranslitTitle   = Rukia Hangeki! Kesshi no Kidō o Hanate
| NativeTitle     = ルキア反撃！決死の鬼道を放て
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Masami Anno
| DirectedBy      = [[Mitsue Yamazaki]]
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2008|1|9}}
| AltDate         = October 11, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Rukia continues to struggle against Kaien, and he begins to overpower her when he uses the ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#shikai|shikai]]'' of his ''zanpakutō''. When Kaien disarms her, Rukia attempts to use a ''[[kidō]]'' spell, and reveals in the process that Kaien is [[Photophobia|afraid of the sunlight]]. Armed with this knowledge, Rukia binds Kaien with ''kidō'' and blasts a hole in the wall. In the sunlight, Kaien's face melts away to reveal a glass case with two masks inside. The creature reintroduces himself as Aaroniero, and after moving out of the sunlight, assumes Kaien's appearance again. After informing Rukia that he absorbed Kaien's remains when he came to Hueco Mundo, Aaroniero releases his ''zanpakutō'', transforming his lower body into a giant, octopus-like form.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}
{{Episode list/sublist

| EpisodeNumber   = 156
| EpisodeNumber2  = 5
| Title           = Ishida & Pesche, the United Attack of Friendship

| AltDate         = October 11, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Uryū continues to battle with Cirucci, who blocks all of his attacks with her ''zanpakutō''. The arrancar [[List of hollows in Bleach#Pesche Guatiche|Pesche Guatiche]] decides to help Uryū, and uses his saliva to cause Cirucci to trip and land awkwardly on the ground. Incensed, Cirucci releases her ''zanpakutō'', referred to as Resurrección, transforming into a giant bird with bladed wings. Unable to counter her abilities with his arrows alone, Uryū pulls one of the tubes from his belt, which produces a powerful energy blade that easily slices through her winged blades.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}

After taking several blows, Chad realizes how to access his full power, transforming his right arm into a giant shield named Brazo Derecho del Gigante.

{{Episode list/sublist

| Title           = Yasutora Sado Dies! Orihime's Tears
| TranslitTitle   = Sado Yasutora Shisu! Orihime no Namida

| NativeTitleLangCode = ja

| DirectedBy      = Kiyomu Fukuda
| WrittenBy       = Rika Nakase
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2008|2|6}}
| AltDate         = October 25, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Bored with the ease of his victory, Nnoitora leaves to pursue another intruder. Chad's apparent death is felt by everyone in Hueco Mundo, and when Espada [[List of hollows in Bleach#Ulquiorra Schiffer|Ulquiorra Schiffer]] brings dinner to [[Orihime Inoue]], she refuses to believe that Chad has died. Ulquiorra admonishes her, noting that all her friends are doomed to fail because they rushed into battle without realizing the odds they faced. Orihime slaps him, and bursts into tears after Ulquiorra leaves. Meanwhile, [[Renji Abarai]] and [[List of hollows in Bleach#Dondochakka Bilstin|Dondochakka Bilstin]] encounter Szayelaporro. Renji attempts to use his ''bankai'', but it shatters instantly, leading Szayelaporro to remark that he designed the room they are in to negate Renji's ''bankai''. As this is happening, Rukia continues to battle Aaroniero, who reveals that he has eaten and obtained the powers of over 33,650 hollows.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}
{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 8
| EpisodeNumber   = 160
| EpisodeNumber2  = 9
| Title           = Testament, Your Heart is Right Here...
| TranslitTitle   = Yuigon, Kokoro wa Koko ni...
| NativeTitle     = 遺言、心はここに…
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja

| DirectedBy      = Mitsutaka Noshitani
| WrittenBy       = Genki Yoshimura

| AltDate         = October 25, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Overwhelmed by Aaroniero's released form, as well as the realization that he possesses Kaien's actual body, Rukia is impaled through the stomach, and her ''zanpakutō'', Sode no Shirayuki, is broken in the process. She recalls her training with Kaien, in which he told her how a person's heart is passed on to those they are close to. Regaining her resolve, she performs the third dance ''San No Mai Shirafune'', reconstructing her ''zanpakutō'' with ice and impales Aaroniero through the head. As Aaroniero dies, Rukia attempts to stand in order to continue her journey to save Orihime, but collapses from her injuries.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}

| ShortSummary    = When Renji asks Szayelaporro how he negated his ''bankai'', Szayelaporro reveals that he gathered the data using parasites stored in the body of his older brother Ilfort Grantz, who Renji fought and defeated. With only his ''shikai'', Renji's attacks cannot harm Szayelaporro. Meanwhile, Ulquiorra meets Ichigo to inform him of Rukia's death. Ichigo attempts to leave to save Rukia, but Ulquiorra goads him into fighting by revealing that he was the person who forced Orihime to come to Hueco Mundo. Furious, Ichigo uses his ''bankai,'' dons his hollow mask and prepares to fight Ulquiorra in anger.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}

Meanwhile, Orihime is confronted by [[List of hollows in Bleach#Loly Aivirrne and Menoly Mallia|Loly Aivirrne and Menoly Mallia]], two female arrancar furious because Aizen favors Orihime over them. In Renji's fight with Szayelaporro. | AltDate         = November 15, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Grimmjow, pleased that Ichigo is fighting with his full power, releases his ''zanpakutō''. The two continue their fight, and Ichigo is slowly worn down by Grimmjow despite the fact that he is able to use his hollow mask longer than he previously could. Espada [[List of hollows in Bleach#Tier Harribel|Tia Halibel]] and her ''Fracciones'', the [[List of Hollows in Bleach#Tres Bestias|Tres Bestias]] (which consists of Emilou Apacci, Franceska Mila Rose and Cyan Sung-Sun), are seen watching the fight and comment during it. Halibel tells them that it is natural that they are afraid of Grimmjow and Ichigo, that it is more like a fight between two Espadas than anything else. Orihime, frightened by Ichigo's appearance due to his hollow mask, is afraid to watch the battle, but after Nel admonishes her, she overcomes her fear and cheers Ichigo on, giving him the resolve to deal a blow across Grimmjow's chest.
| LineColor       = 89CFF0
}}
